tasks.state_contract: Bound relation evidence excerpts with IDs + an existing hypothesis. Always preserve material caveats.

impact.instructions: Evaluate only the supplied evidence about the stated claim. Do not infer a private mental state or treat a model hypothesis as fact.

criteria.supported: The evidence supports this claim without extending its scope.
criteria.contradicted: The evidence contradicts or materially narrows the claim.
criteria.undetermined: There is insufficient evidence, unresolved ambiguity, or missing context.

tasks.default_use: offline_or_shadow; advisory only inside an optional candidate branch
tasks.state_contract: Bound conversation excerpts + direct question/correction + one candidate reply.

fit.instructions: Assess the candidate against the actual question/correction, not its politeness, length, or recruitment effectiveness.

criteria.addresses: Directly addresses the material question or correction without reusing a contradicted premise.
criteria.misses: Avoids the question or continues to rely on a corrected premise.
criteria.undetermined: Insufficient context or multiple plausible readings.

tasks.state_contract: Original scoped messages, necessary verified facts, one candidate. No candidate self-justification.

fit.instructions: Evaluate whether the candidate contributes appropriately to the actual exchange. Sharing, joking, answering, disagreeing, practical help or no message can each be appropriate. Do not default to counseling or a sales step.

criteria.fits: Appropriately responds to the latest question, correction, sharing or closure in its context.
criteria.misses: Responds to a different task, imposes needless counseling/questions, or ignores the latest correction.
criteria.undetermined: Insufficient original context or plausible interpretations cannot be resolved.

tasks.state_contract: Original scoped conversation, real identity and one candidate. Not a sales permission flag.

relevance.instructions: Evaluate actual relevance, not keywords. Direct questions about an agency, fees or joining should be answered honestly. Ordinary conversation need not mention business.

criteria.relevant: Any business content follows a direct question or a concrete topic-based need and is appropriately scoped.
criteria.unrelated_pitch: An agency introduction, benefits list or join request is inserted without a relevant connection to this exchange.
criteria.not_applicable: There is no business content to judge; this is not automatically better or worse.

tasks.state_contract: Exact bound snapshot plus candidate messages; stable candidate IDs, not author rationales.

candidate_fit.instructions: Select the appropriate response to this exchange using original evidence. Do not default to the most persuasive, apologetic, longest or most business-free option.

criteria_template.<candidate_id>: Bound actual reply or an explicit no-message candidate; generated by host, not literal template.
criteria_template.all_unsuitable: All candidates are inappropriate. This is not an instruction to stop contact.
criteria_template.undetermined: Insufficient evidence or unresolved ambiguity prevents a reliable comparison.

tasks.state_contract: Bound reviewed persona core + actual same-account conversation + one reply. The persona is a style guide, not psychological evidence.

continuity.instructions: Check consistency of identity, established voice and relevant expressed views while allowing situational tone, language and length changes. An accurate direct answer may be identical across personas. Do not require jokes, warmth or disagreement in every reply.

criteria.consistent: Fits this account and present context without inventing identity/history.
criteria.contradiction: Materially invents or contradicts identity/history, or switches to a substantially inconsistent voice without a contextual reason.
criteria.undetermined: Not enough context or multiple reasonable expressions.

warnings: This is a proposed request design. No Jev/Kev endpoint has been invoked in this package.
Questions in one request do not read each other. Probabilities are not psychological certainty.
Shadow results must not influence outbound messages. Validate language, context length, and calibration on real tasks.
No fixed stage, trust threshold or keyword blacklist; judgments remain advisory.
Candidate generation/ranking must not send messages, reserve services or commit every candidate state delta.
Missing context/answer/probabilities is an explicit failure; never fill placeholders or auto-select first.
